## One rule, four ideas { background-color="#208F6E" data-color="white"}

```{.python code-line-numbers="|1|2-3|4-6|7"}
rule align:
    input:  "fastq/{sample}.fq.gz"      # wildcards
    output: "bam/{sample}.bam"
    threads: 8
    resources: mem_mb=16_000, runtime=120
    conda:  "envs/bwa.yaml"             # per-rule software
    shell:  "bwa mem -t {threads} ref {input} | samtools sort -o {output}"
```

::: {.columns style="margin-top: 1em;"}
::: {.column width="25%"}
<i class="mdi mdi-puzzle-outline" style="color: #208F6E;"></i> **Rule**
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
<i class="mdi mdi-asterisk" style="color: #208F6E;"></i> **Wildcards**
:::

<i class="mdi mdi-cpu-64-bit" style="color: #208F6E;"></i> **Resources**
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
<i class="mdi mdi-package-variant" style="color: #208F6E;"></i> **Env per rule**
:::

## How execution works

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
<i class="mdi mdi-arrow-left-bold-circle" style="font-size: 2.5em; color: #208F6E;"></i>

### Pull-based DAG

Ask for an output file → Snakemake recurses back to find what's needed → builds the static DAG → schedules jobs.

`--dry-run` shows the full plan before anything executes.
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
<i class="mdi mdi-shield-check" style="font-size: 2.5em; color: #208F6E;"></i>

### Reproducibility built-in

- `conda:` / `container:` per rule
- `--report report.html` provenance
- `.snakemake/` tracks code, params, inputs, env hashes
:::
:::

::: {.notes}
This is the conceptual anchor for the whole talk. Pull-based DAG is what makes the v9 storage staging story work cleanly.
:::

# {.section-divider background-color="#8E44AD"}

::: {style="text-align: center;"}
<i class="mdi mdi-puzzle" style="font-size: 4em; color: #fff;"></i>

<h1 style="color: #fff;">v7 → v9</h1>
<p style="color: #e8d5f5; font-size: 0.7em;">v8 (Jan 2024) was the re-architecture · v9 is mostly invisible</p>
:::

## Monolith → plugin framework

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}

<h3 style="color: #8E44AD;"><i class="mdi mdi-package-variant-closed"></i>&nbsp; v7 (monolith)</h3>

All executors, all remote-storage backends, all software-deployment options shipped in **one package**.

```bash
snakemake --use-conda \
          --use-singularity \
          --cluster "sbatch ..."
```
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

<h3 style="color: #8E44AD;"><i class="mdi mdi-puzzle"></i>&nbsp; v8 / v9 (plugins)</h3>

Engine + **5 plugin types**, each pip-installable:

- <i class="mdi mdi-server"></i>&nbsp; **Executor** — slurm, k8s, googlebatch, …
- <i class="mdi mdi-database"></i>&nbsp; **Storage** — fs, s3, gcs, zenodo, …
- <i class="mdi mdi-text-box"></i>&nbsp; **Logger** — snkmt, …
- <i class="mdi mdi-file-document"></i>&nbsp; **Report** — rocrate, nanopub, …
- <i class="mdi mdi-clock-fast"></i>&nbsp; **Scheduler** — greedy, ilp, milp
:::
:::

## Executor & storage in practice {.smaller}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
<h3 style="color: #8E44AD;"><i class="mdi mdi-server"></i> Executor</h3>

```bash
pip install snakemake-executor-plugin-slurm
snakemake --executor slurm --jobs 100
```

Available: `slurm` · `lsf` · `htcondor` · `kubernetes` ·
`googlebatch` · `azure-batch` · `flux` · `cluster-generic`

[catalog](https://snakemake.github.io/snakemake-plugin-catalog/)
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
<h3 style="color: #8E44AD;"><i class="mdi mdi-database"></i> Storage</h3>

```python
storage:
    provider="s3",
    max_requests_per_second=10

rule x:
    input: storage("s3://bucket/in.txt")
```

Or workflow-wide: `--default-storage-provider s3`
:::
:::

## Software deployment unified

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #8E44AD;">v7 — many flags</h4>
```bash
--use-conda
--use-singularity
--use-envmodules
--conda-frontend mamba
```
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #8E44AD;">v8 / v9 — one flag</h4>
```bash
--sdm conda
--sdm apptainer
--sdm conda apptainer
--sdm env-modules
```
:::
:::

::: {style="margin-top: 1em;"}
<i class="mdi mdi-information" style="color: #8E44AD;"></i>&nbsp; `--conda-frontend mamba` removed · `libmamba` is the default solver · Pixi backend on the roadmap.
:::

## CLI rename cheat sheet {.smaller}

| v7 | v8 / v9 |
|----|---------|
| `--cluster "sbatch ..."` | `--executor cluster-generic --cluster-generic-submit-cmd "sbatch ..."` |
| `--drmaa` | removed (pick an executor plugin) |
| `--kubernetes` · `--google-lifesciences` · `--tibanna` | `--executor <name>` |
| `--use-conda` · `--use-singularity` · `--use-envmodules` | `--sdm <name>` |
| `--singularity-args` | `--apptainer-args` |
| `--conda-frontend mamba` | <i class="mdi mdi-close-circle" style="color: #C0392B;"></i> removed |
| `--restart-times N` | `--retries N` |

<i class="mdi mdi-camera" style="color: #8E44AD;"></i>&nbsp; *Photographable slide — profile schema is now versioned too: `config.v8+.yaml`*

## Highlights · 9.17 → 9.21 {.smaller}

| <i class="mdi mdi-tag"></i> | <i class="mdi mdi-star"></i> Headline |
|---|---|
| **9.17** | Pluggable metadata persistence (files or DB) · lambda rule `priority` |
| **9.18** | Storage plugins expose **checksums** → cross-workflow cache correctness |
| **9.19** | `profile.yaml` is the new default filename · pass a YAML file directly |
| **9.20** | Named multi-output caching · `subpath(with_suffix=...)` · <i class="mdi mdi-alert" style="color: #E67E22;"></i> **`runtime` now in *minutes*** (was seconds) |
| **9.21** | Filename-prefix helper · tuned SQLite PRAGMAs · auto-detect network FS type |

::: {.callout-warning}
**Footgun:** `runtime: 60` in a profile meant *60 seconds* before 9.20 — now *60 minutes*.
:::

## Migration footguns

::: {.incremental}
- <i class="mdi mdi-close-circle" style="color: #C0392B;"></i>&nbsp; `dynamic()` outputs → use **checkpoints**
- <i class="mdi mdi-close-circle" style="color: #C0392B;"></i>&nbsp; `version:` directive → use `conda:` / `container:`
- <i class="mdi mdi-close-circle" style="color: #C0392B;"></i>&nbsp; `subworkflow:` → `module:` + `use rule * from foo as foo_*`
- <i class="mdi mdi-close-circle" style="color: #C0392B;"></i>&nbsp; `from snakemake.remote.*` → `storage` directive
- <i class="mdi mdi-alert" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; CI must `pip install snakemake-executor-plugin-slurm` explicitly
- <i class="mdi mdi-alert" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; v9.20: audit `runtime:` values (seconds → minutes)
- <i class="mdi mdi-alert" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; v7 profiles reference removed flags — silently broken on v8
:::

::: {style="text-align: center; padding-top: 1em;"}
<img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/33450111?s=120&v=4" style="height: 90px; border-radius: 12px; vertical-align: middle;" alt="Snakemake"/>
<span style="font-size: 3em; color: #fff; margin: 0 0.5em; vertical-align: middle;">vs</span>
<img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/6698688?s=120&v=4" style="height: 90px; border-radius: 12px; vertical-align: middle;" alt="Nextflow"/>

<h1 style="color: #fff; margin-top: 0.6em;">Snakemake vs Nextflow</h1>
<p style="color: #d4e8f5; font-size: 0.6em;">Strictly objective · pick on <em>fit</em>, not on taste</p>
:::

## The deepest difference — dataflow

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}

<h3 style="color: #2980B9;"><i class="mdi mdi-arrow-left-bold-circle"></i>&nbsp; Snakemake — **pull**</h3>

Target-driven, Make-style.

> *"What file do I want?"*

- Request output → recurse back
- Static DAG, built up-front
- `--dry-run` shows the full plan
- Conditional flow via Python / checkpoints
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

<h3 style="color: #2980B9;"><i class="mdi mdi-arrow-right-bold-circle"></i>&nbsp; Nextflow — **push**</h3>

Channel-driven, Kahn / CSP-style.

> *"What stream into what process?"*

- Channels emit records
- Processes fire on input availability
- Dynamic DAG, materializes at runtime
- Branching native via operators
:::
:::

## Resume / cache — myth-buster

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #2980B9;"><i class="mdi mdi-clock-outline"></i>&nbsp; Snakemake</h4>

File timestamps + tracked metadata in `.snakemake/`.

Triggers: `--rerun-triggers {mtime, params, input, software-env, code}`.

*Make pitfall:* touching an input invalidates downstream.
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #2980B9;"><i class="mdi mdi-hash"></i>&nbsp; Nextflow</h4>

Hash in `.nextflow/cache/` (LevelDB).

Hashes script + input *attributes* (path/size/**mtime**) by default — **not contents**.

`cache 'deep'` → true content hash · `cache 'lenient'` for shared FS.
:::
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
*"Nextflow -resume is content-hashed"* — **partially false**. Default = file attributes incl. mtime. Both tools are sensitive to FS metadata. Neither is magic.
:::

## Executor matrix {.smaller .scrollable}

| | <i class="mdi mdi-snake" style="color: #208F6E;"></i> Snakemake | <i class="mdi mdi-source-branch" style="color: #5e9c1e;"></i> Nextflow |
|---|---|---|
| SLURM · LSF · HTCondor · Kubernetes · Flux | <i class="mdi mdi-check-circle" style="color: #208F6E;"></i> plugins | <i class="mdi mdi-check-circle" style="color: #5e9c1e;"></i> built-in |
| Google Batch · Azure Batch | <i class="mdi mdi-check-circle" style="color: #208F6E;"></i> plugins | <i class="mdi mdi-check-circle" style="color: #5e9c1e;"></i> built-in |
| SGE · PBS · OAR · Moab · NQSII | <i class="mdi mdi-account-multiple"></i> community | <i class="mdi mdi-check-circle" style="color: #5e9c1e;"></i> built-in |
| **AWS Batch** | <i class="mdi mdi-close-circle" style="color: #C0392B;"></i> no official plugin | <i class="mdi mdi-check-circle" style="color: #5e9c1e;"></i> `awsbatch` first-class |
| TES | <i class="mdi mdi-account-multiple"></i> community | <i class="mdi mdi-check-circle" style="color: #5e9c1e;"></i> built-in |

::: {.callout-warning}
*"Snakemake can't do cloud"* — **false** (K8s · GCP · Azure are official).
*"Snakemake can't do AWS Batch"* — closer to true (no official plugin).
:::

## Software & containers

| | <i class="mdi mdi-snake" style="color: #208F6E;"></i> Snakemake | <i class="mdi mdi-source-branch" style="color: #5e9c1e;"></i> Nextflow / nf-core |
|---|---|---|
| Per-rule env | `conda:` + `container:` | `conda` + `container` directive |
| Compose | `--sdm conda apptainer` | engine + conda |
| Curated registry | snakemake-wrappers | BioContainers · mulled · **Seqera Containers** |
| Build on demand | — | **Wave** (Apache-2.0 OSS) |
| POSIX over S3/GCS | — | **Fusion** (commercial) |

::: {.callout-warning}
**Wave is open-source.** Fusion is part of the commercial Seqera Platform.
:::

## When does each fit?

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #2980B9;"><i class="mdi mdi-snake"></i>&nbsp; Snakemake fits when…</h4>

- Team is <i class="mdi mdi-language-python"></i> Python-native
- Pipeline is **file / target-driven**
- You want the **DAG up-front**
- Debugging needs interactive Python
- One Snakefile, readable end-to-end
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #2980B9;"><i class="mdi mdi-source-branch"></i>&nbsp; Nextflow fits when…</h4>

- Team has Groovy / JVM people
- Pipeline is **stream / event-driven**
- **AWS Batch** or **Fusion** matter
- You want **nf-core** off-the-shelf
- You want **Seqera Platform** observability
:::
:::

## Five pillars { background-color="#fdf2e9"}

::: {.columns style="margin-top: 1em;"}
::: {.column width="20%" style="text-align: center;"}
<i class="mdi mdi-cached" style="font-size: 3em; color: #E67E22;"></i>

**Workflow caching**

`SNAKEMAKE_OUTPUT_CACHE`
:::
::: {.column width="20%" style="text-align: center;"}
<i class="mdi mdi-docker" style="font-size: 3em; color: #E67E22;"></i>

**Container caching**

Shared `apptainer-prefix`
:::
::: {.column width="20%" style="text-align: center;"}
<i class="mdi mdi-database" style="font-size: 3em; color: #E67E22;"></i>

**Storage staging**

`fs` plugin · scratch
:::
::: {.column width="20%" style="text-align: center;"}
<i class="mdi mdi-group" style="font-size: 3em; color: #E67E22;"></i>

**Job grouping & arrays**

`group:` · `--group-components`
:::
::: {.column width="20%" style="text-align: center;"}
<i class="mdi mdi-package-variant" style="font-size: 3em; color: #E67E22;"></i>

**EESSI / env-modules**

`--sdm env-modules`
:::
:::

## 1 · Caching — workflow + containers

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #E67E22;"><i class="mdi mdi-cached"></i>&nbsp; Workflow output cache</h4>

```bash
export SNAKEMAKE_OUTPUT_CACHE=\
  /scratch_cached/<group>/snakemake_cache
```

Per rule:
```python
rule index_ref:
    output: "ref.fa.bwt"
    cache: True   # shared across users
```

Computed indexes (BWA, STAR, ref dicts) reused across users → minutes saved per run.
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #E67E22;"><i class="mdi mdi-docker"></i>&nbsp; Container & conda cache</h4>

```yaml
# profile
conda-prefix:     /g/<group>/shared/conda
apptainer-prefix: /g/<group>/shared/apptainer
```

<i class="mdi mdi-folder-lock" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; Group-writable, `chmod 2775` (setgid) → no per-user re-solves.

<i class="mdi mdi-rocket" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; Pre-warm: `snakemake --conda-create-envs-only`
:::
:::

## 2 · Storage — staging via `fs` plugin

```{.yaml filename="profile/config.yaml" code-line-numbers="|2|3|4-7"}
executor: slurm
default-storage-provider: fs                       # auto-stage to scratch
local-storage-prefix: /scratch/$USER/snakemake/<wf>
shared-fs-usage:                                   # what stays on shared FS
  - persistence
  - software-deployment
  - sources                                        # NOT input-output!
```

| <i class="mdi mdi-file"></i> Data | <i class="mdi mdi-harddisk"></i> Tier | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Reference genomes · indexes | Cached parallel FS | Read 100× |
| BAM / CRAM intermediates | Parallel FS | Sequential writes |
| Conda · containers | Parallel FS (shared) | Multi-user reuse |
| Sorting · temp buffers | **Local scratch** | Ultra-fast, per-job |

## 3 · Job grouping — fewer SLURM submissions

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="55%"}
```python
rule trim:
    input:  "fastq/{s}.fq.gz"
    output: "trim/{s}.fq.gz"
    group:  "preproc"   # ◀ same group

rule align:
    input:  "trim/{s}.fq.gz"
    output: "bam/{s}.bam"
    group:  "preproc"   # ◀ same SLURM job
```

CLI knobs:
```bash
--groups rulename=fast
--group-components fast=10
```
:::

::: {.column width="45%"}
<i class="mdi mdi-lightbulb-on" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; **One sbatch instead of two** per sample.

<i class="mdi mdi-lightbulb-on" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; Shares scratch between rules.

<i class="mdi mdi-lightbulb-on" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; Resource math: <br/>
&nbsp;&nbsp;parallel → sum cpus, max runtime <br/>
&nbsp;&nbsp;serial → max cpus, sum runtime
:::
:::

## 4 · Job arrays — submitting at scale

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="55%"}
For thousands of similar samples, the SLURM executor plugin batches Snakemake jobs into **`sbatch --array=…`** submissions automatically.

```yaml
# profile
executor: slurm
slurm-job-array: true       # opt-in batching
jobs: 500
max-jobs-per-second: 10     # throttle controller
```

<i class="mdi mdi-information" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; Combined with `group:` → array of grouped jobs.
:::

::: {.column width="45%"}
<i class="mdi mdi-checkbox-marked-circle" style="color: #2ECC71;"></i>&nbsp; **Fewer scheduler RPCs**

<i class="mdi mdi-checkbox-marked-circle" style="color: #2ECC71;"></i>&nbsp; Single `squeue` entry

<i class="mdi mdi-checkbox-marked-circle" style="color: #2ECC71;"></i>&nbsp; Per-task logs preserved (`%A_%a`)

<i class="mdi mdi-alert" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; Heterogeneous resources → keep separate
:::
:::

## 5 · EESSI — env-modules everywhere

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="55%"}
**EESSI** = European Environment for Scientific Software Installations — a CernVM-FS stream of pre-built scientific software, mountable on any HPC.

```bash
source /cvmfs/software.eessi.io/versions/2023.06/init/bash
module load BWA SAMtools STAR
```

Per rule:
```python
rule align:
    envmodules: "BWA/0.7.17", "SAMtools/1.18"
    shell: "bwa mem ... | samtools sort ..."
```
Invoke with `--sdm env-modules`.
:::

::: {.column width="45%"}
<i class="mdi mdi-rocket-launch" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; **No conda solve · no image pull**

<i class="mdi mdi-earth" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; Identical tool versions across sites

<i class="mdi mdi-shield-check" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; Reproducibility comparable to containers

[eessi.io](https://www.eessi.io)
:::
:::

## Bonus · dependency cooldowns { background-color="#fef5e7"}

<h4 style="color: #F39C12;"><i class="mdi mdi-shield-lock"></i>&nbsp; Why</h4>

Malicious PyPI / conda releases are usually yanked within hours to days. Tell your resolver to ignore versions published in the last *N* days → compromised releases disappear before your build ever sees them. Bonus: dampens surprise breakage.

::: {.columns style="margin-top: 0.6em;"}
::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #F39C12;"><i class="mdi mdi-language-python"></i>&nbsp; pip 26.1 (Apr 2026)</h4>

```bash
pip install --uploaded-prior-to=P7D requests
```

- 26.0 → absolute date only · 26.1 → ISO-8601 relative duration
- Also in `pip.conf`
- Relies on PEP 700 upload time (PyPI; may no-op on custom indexes)
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #F39C12;"><i class="mdi mdi-package-variant"></i>&nbsp; Pixi · `exclude-newer`</h4>

```toml
[workspace]
exclude-newer = "14d"
channels = [
  "conda-forge",
  { channel = ".../internal", exclude-newer = "0d" }
]

[exclude-newer]
openssl = "0d"   # bypass for urgent CVE
```
:::
:::

::: {style="font-size: 0.6em; margin-top: 0.6em; color: #7f8c8d;"}
Same concept as uv/rattler · 7 days is the commonly cited default · [Richard Si's writeup](https://ichard26.github.io/blog/2026/04/whats-new-in-pip-26.1/)
:::
